title: pvOMFReader
body:
## pvOMFReader

Reads an Open Mining Format (.omf) project into a partitioned dataset collection with one entry per selected element: point sets (e.g. drill-hole samples), line sets, surfaces and block-model volumes, with their attribute data. Use it for geological and mining models. Elements are not loaded unless selected in DataElements.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK disables every element by default, so list the elements you need in DataElements or the output may be empty.
- If block-model volumes look scrambled, the file was written column-major; enable ColumnMajorOrdering.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `OMFReader`. Identity: `sources/OMFReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ColumnMajorOrdering` | Are volumes written in column major data order as opposed to standard row major order. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DataElements` | Select which data elements to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property sets the OMF file to be read. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvOMFReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
